meta.title: Recurring PO: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and attempt to create or enable a Recurring PO on the specified Enterprise tenant.
Repeat the same Recurring PO action as a Buyer and compare whether it is offered or succeeds.
Observe the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to roles beyond Buyer.
